messages:
dana_csm: FYI renewal for SilvaTech due next week. They changed billing to 'SilvaTech EU SARL' and want a delegated procurement sign. CFO away Tue-Thu.
rex_cs: Do we have their VAT and new vendor code? Need to patch amendment before legal.
kevin_finance: Vendor code ST-EU-334. VAT FR556677889. PO ref: ST-PO-095. Invoice to be sent to billing@silvatech.eu.
marta_legal: Delegated signing allowed if they provide a delegation letter referencing the procurement contact. Add clause: "Delegation reference" in signature block + attestation checkbox in envelope.
oliver_sales: They also requested a 10-month term instead of 12 with prorated pricing. Is that acceptable?
kevin_finance: 10mo works. Prorated total = $39,200. Invoice terms net30 to SilvaTech EU SARL. Include VAT field for reverse-charge.
dana_csm: @docusign_bot please create envelope routing: procurement_delegate -> finance (kevin_finance) -> legal (marta_legal). Add checkbox text: "I confirm authority per delegation letter". Attach delegation letter when ready.
docusign_bot: Envelope created env_ST_334. Routing set. Checkbox placeholder added. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_ST_334
rex_cs: Uploaded amendment_v1.pdf with entity change and KMS fingerprint (customer insisted on customer-managed keys).
marta_legal: Minor wording tweak: replace "signature date" with "execution date" and add delegation reference number. Approved.
docusign_bot: Envelope env_ST_334 updated and sent to procurement_delegate at 2024-08-02T15:04:00Z.
docusign_bot: procurement_delegate signed at 2024-08-02T15:22:10Z. Next: kevin_finance.
kevin_finance: Signed and uploaded invoice PDF with VAT field filled.
docusign_bot: kevin_finance signed at 2024-08-02T15:45:01Z. Next: marta_legal.
marta_legal: Signed at 2024-08-02T16:01:30Z. Envelope complete. Final doc: https://docusign.example/env/env_ST_334/final.pdf
oliver_sales: Customer confirmed they posted VAT docs in portal and onboarding can start once procurement signs.
dana_csm: Renewal executed. Updating tracker and scheduling onboarding kickoff Mon. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
